name: deepsec-security
description: DeepSec Shield and Spear security auditing for AI-generated code.

commands.title: DeepSec: Ignore Rule in This File
DeepSec: Apply All Safe Fixes in Current File
DeepSec: Review and Apply All Pro Fixes in Current File

deepsec.scanOnChange.description: Scan supported documents shortly after edits.

deepsec.scanOnSave.description: Scan supported documents when they are saved.

deepsec.packageVerification.description: How VSCode verifies package names. Remote mode keeps edit-time diagnostics non-blocking by checking the local seed/index first, then verifies unknown packages against npm, PyPI, Cargo, Go modules, and Maven Central.

deepsec.deepsecPythonPath.description: Optional Python interpreter for DeepSec Shield scanning. When empty, the bundled DeepSec TypeScript engine remains active.

deepsec.autoSyncPackageCache.description: Automatically sync the local package-name cache in the background when VSCode starts.

deepsec.packageCacheLanguages.description: Package registries to keep in the local package-name cache. Explicit VSCode settings override config.json package_cache.languages.

deepsec.packageCacheUpdateInterval.description: How often VSCode background sync refreshes package-name indexes.

deepsec.packageCacheLightweightMode.description: Use lightweight partial package-name indexes for faster cold starts.

deepsec.packageCacheBackgroundFullSync.description: After the quick package-name index is ready, continue refreshing a full index in the background. Disable to keep lightweight partial indexes only.

deepsec.enableL2.description: Enable lightweight asynchronous SAST rules for SQL injection, XSS, SSRF, path traversal, unsafe deserialization, and command injection.

deepsec.l2DebounceMs.description: Delay in milliseconds before VSCode runs L2 SAST analysis after edits. L1 diagnostics still run immediately.

deepsec.enableL3.description: Enable L3 semantic security checks. When an LLM provider and credential are available, DeepSec uses them; otherwise it falls back to local endpoint heuristics.

deepsec.l3DebounceMs.description: Delay in milliseconds before VSCode runs L3 semantic analysis after edits. Saves and manual scans run L3 immediately.

deepsec.llmProvider.description: LLM provider for DeepSec L3 semantic analysis. API keys are stored with VSCode SecretStorage or read from environment variables.

deepsec.llmModel.description: Optional model override for L3 semantic analysis.

deepsec.llmBaseUrl.description: Optional provider base URL override for L3 semantic analysis. Remote endpoints must use HTTPS; HTTP is allowed only for loopback local development hosts.

deepsec.dedupWithExistingTools.description: Dismiss duplicate L2 findings when nearby SonarQube, Snyk, Semgrep, or CodeQL annotations already cover the same issue.

deepsec.storeFindings.description: Store scan runs and findings in a local SQLite database.

deepsec.ignoredFindings.description: Exact finding IDs to dismiss in addition to config.json ignored_findings.

deepsec.customRules.description: Paths to custom DeepSec YAML rule files. Relative paths resolve from the workspace folder.

deepsec.showCriticalPopups.description: Show warning popups for newly detected critical findings.
